title: Investigative Technician
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Investigative Technician - Certificate of Achievement - CE980
outcomes: Demonstrate a basic knowledge of the principle components of criminal law and the criminal justice system.
Understand the comprehensive structure of the criminal justice system from the beginning of an investigation through arrest, booking, pre-trial process, trial, and sentencing.
Understand the comprehensive structure of the criminal justice system from the beginning of an investigation through arrest, booking, pre-trial process, trial, and sentencing.
Demonstrate a basic knowledge of state and federal rules of evidence.
Demonstrate a basic knowledge of the procedures and process of collecting, preserving, and cataloging physical evidence from a crime scene.
Demonstrate an advanced knowledge of specialized criminal investigation techniques.
Demonstrate the ability to utilize professional and multicultural communication strategies within criminal justice, including interviewing skills.
Demonstrate the ability to properly write official reports related to the collection, preservation, and presentation of crime scene evidence.

notes: The catalog prints the outcome 'Understand the comprehensive structure of the criminal justice system...' twice in a row; both printed lines are recorded as printed. A reviewer may wish to treat it as a single outcome.
ADJ-13 (Criminal Investigation) and ADJ-14 (Advanced Criminal Investigation) are in the catalog's required list but not in the closed list; marked as catalog additions.
Codes are recorded with hyphens as the catalog prints them (e.g., ADJ-2 for closed-list ADJ 2).
The catalog's stated total of 22.00 units is consistent with a Certificate of Achievement of 16 to fewer than 30 semester units.
